title: Rebuild a component in one batch
about: Retro item 5 (C1, C2): rebuilding a component left its old Swiped Left and Swiped Right outputs behind, and patches recreated in a later batch came back as card_gone_2. The checks look for stale ports and for numbered copies of removed ids.

checks.description: Swipe Card has one output, Flipped, and no swipe ports
